text.en:
Subject to the terms and conditions established in Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred and
thirty-six, as amended by Commonwealth Act Numbered One hundred and thirty-two, and to the provisions of
the Constitution, there is granted to Aurelia S. de Intengan, for a period of twenty-five years from the approval
of this Act, the right, privelege, and authority to construct, maintain and operate an electric light, heat, and
power plant for the purpose of generating and distributing electric light, heat, and/or power for sale within the
limits of the municipality of Balamban, Province of Cebu.

It expressly provided that in the event the Government should desire to maintain and operate for
itself the plant and the enterprise herein authorized, the grantee shall surrender its franchise and will turn over
to the Government all serviceable equipments therein, at cost, less reasonable depreciation.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted, without Executive approval, June 22, 1941.
